cards.name: Notes
cards.summary: Imports annotations (notes) from another file, typically a PDF or Acrobat FDF comment file, into the active document as Photoshop notes: small non-printing comment markers listed in the Notes panel. It opens a 'Load' file dialog and needs an open document.
cards.how: Pick the PDF or FDF that holds the comments in the Load dialog; the notes land on the canvas and in Window > Notes, where they can be read, stepped through and deleted.
use_for: bringing a client's PDF proof comments back into the layered PSD as on-canvas notes
keeping review remarks next to the retouch they refer to while revising a poster
avoid: visible text on the design: notes never print or export; use the Type tool
notes in delivered images: they are dropped from JPEG/PNG exports and never print

cards.name: Variable Data Sets
cards.summary: Imports data sets for Photoshop's data-driven graphics from a delimited text file (CSV or tab-delimited): the first row names the variables, each later row becomes one data set that fills the document's text-replacement, image-replacement and visibility variables. The harvest found it disabled in every scratch state tried, probably because those documents had no variables defined (Image > Variables > Define); that cause is unconfirmed.
cards.how: Choose the text file, then set Use First Column For Data Set Names, Replace Existing Data Sets, and the encoding. Step through the sets in Image > Variables > Data Sets, then render one file per set with File > Export > Data Sets as Files.
use_for: name badges, certificates or price cards from a spreadsheet, one PSD layout filled per row
social posts in many variants with swapped headline text and product photo
avoid: a document with no variables defined yet: define them first in Image > Variables > Define
complex multi-page layouts: Illustrator variables or CorelDRAW Print Merge handle vector or page-based merges better
cards.script_api: No confirmed route. Candidate app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('importDataSets')) errored live ('General Photoshop error ... not currently available') while the command was disabled.

review.changes: none: the importDataSets candidate failed live while disabled, so scriptable no is right; cause stays unconfirmed; AI Variables and CDR Print Merge cards point back here

cards.name: Video Frames to Layers
cards.summary: Opens a video file and turns its frames into a new layered document, one layer per frame. It first shows an 'Open' file dialog for the clip, then a range dialog; it works with or without a document open.
cards.how: After picking the clip choose From Beginning To End or Selected Range Only (trim with the scrubber), Limit To Every N Frames to thin the count, and Make Frame Animation to also build a frame timeline for GIF export.
use_for: picking the sharpest still from a short clip for a poster or thumbnail
frame-by-frame paint-over or rotoscope animation
building an animated GIF or sprite sheet from a few seconds of footage
avoid: long or high-resolution clips: every frame becomes a full layer and memory runs out; trim first or use Limit To Every N Frames
editing the video itself: open it with File > Open as a video layer or use a video editor

cards.summary: Installed script (Load DICOM.jsx) that asks for a folder and loads every DICOM medical image in it (.dcm, .dc3, .dic or no extension) into one new document named 'DICOM Files' (with a number added when other documents are open), one layer per file. The document is grayscale or RGB to match the first file, transparent, and trimmed to the content. The harvest did not run it.
cards.how: Pick the folder in the folder dialog; if it holds no DICOM files the script says so and asks again.
use_for: laying out a series of scan slices for a medical or science explainer graphic
animating through scan slices as frames for an education video
avoid: a single DICOM file: open it with File > Open
clinical diagnosis or editing of medical records: this is for visuals only
